name: Drawing wall
author: spacewaffle42
description: Draw on the panel from your phone, live: several phones at once, a history of the last few, and a pop-up when one is sent if you like.

fields.name: start
fields.label: When someone starts drawing
fields.note: Straight away: the wall cuts in and stays while dots keep coming, until 8 s after the last one. Never in the sleep hours or while paused.

fields.name: popup
fields.label: Pop-up when a drawing is sent
fields.note: The drawing cuts in over whatever's on, for that long. Never in the sleep hours.

fields.name: keep
fields.label: Drawings kept in the history
fields.note: The oldest goes when a new one is sent.

fields.name: clear_by_itself
fields.label: Clear the wall by itself
choices: A day after the last drawing
fields.note: A drawing that was never sent is kept in the history first.

settings.note: Anyone with a paired phone or computer can draw: Open Drawing wall, above, or from its row in Modules. Cutting in and pop-ups never come in the sleep hours or while the panel is paused, and the Matrix allows a module 10 pop-ups in ten minutes: past that, the wall waits for its turn in the playlist.
